## Checklist

- [ ] `make ci` passes
- [ ] New logic has unit tests, including failure paths
- [ ] Real-time code is in a `*_rt.c` file; `make check-rt` passes
- [ ] Hot-path changes: `make bench` numbers added to `docs/PERFORMANCE.md`
- [ ] No system settings, global installs or `sudo` (CLAUDE.md, Safety rules)
- [ ] No key codes, typed text, app names or URLs stored, logged or sent
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` and `docs/DECISIONS.md` updated where needed
